name: Manu Sheel Gupta
description: Manu Sheel Gupta is building LeakDetectAI and is a Technical Lead and maintainer across libp2p, multiformats, and IPLD, working on P2P networking, secure communication channels, PQ clients interoperability, decentralized systems, and open Internet infrastructure. His work focuses on secure, resilient, and permissionless networks through open standards, security research, and open-source development. He is a volunteer and contributes to the Trillion Security Research (1TS) initiative at Ethereum.
